signals.name: observability-transport
signals.source: Prometheus scrape health for the production OpenTelemetry Collector
signals.threshold: OpenTelemetry Collector Prometheus scrape target must be up

signals.name: route-error-rate
signals.source: Prometheus Chase Sets HTTP 5xx rate by route and host

signals.name: route-latency-p95
signals.source: Prometheus Chase Sets HTTP request duration histogram by route and host
signals.threshold: current production p95 <= 50ms until route baselines mature

signals.name: projection-lag-poison-events
signals.source: Prometheus checkout projection freshness pending and error telemetry
signals.threshold: production projection pending/error telemetry must remain zero

signals.name: checkout-order-payment-errors
signals.source: Prometheus checkout command, order, payment, and provider-health failure counters
signals.threshold: production checkout/payment release-health alert events must remain zero

signals.name: settlement-payout-errors
signals.source: Prometheus settlement operation failures for payout setup, readiness, and provider reconciliation
signals.threshold: production settlement payout/setup failures must remain zero
